title: Siena Scalp EEG Database
description: Scalp video-EEG recordings from 14 adults with epilepsy, collected at the Unit of Neurology and Neurophysiology of the University of Siena, Italy. The dataset comprises about 128 hours of recording sampled at 512 Hz, with 47 annotated seizures, 10-20 electrode placement and ECG channels. It was collected for patient-specific seizure prediction research and is distributed here as a BIDS curation of the PhysioNet release, with SzCORE seizure-type annotations as derivatives.
methods_description: Data were acquired with EB Neuro and Natus Quantum LTM amplifiers using reusable silver/gold cup electrodes placed on the international 10-20 system, at a 512 Hz sampling rate. Patients stayed in bed, asleep or awake, during video-EEG monitoring. Seizures were classified according to ILAE criteria by an expert clinician. Original EDF files were kept byte-identical, and seizure annotations were converted to BIDS events.
